solutions.title: Compare all pairs
solutions.strategy: Check every pair of intervals for positive overlap.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every pair of meetings can be compared.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only loop counters are stored beyond the input.

solutions.title: Sort by start
solutions.strategy: Sort intervals by start time and compare each meeting with the previous ending time.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting dominates the linear overlap scan.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The Java sort may use stack space; Python uses a sorted copy in the driver-isolated input.
